title: Where is it?
grammar: Direções (go straight ahead, turn left/right) + preposições de lugar + How do I get to…? / Is there a… near here?
today: Hoje você vai aprender a pedir e dar direção na rua: como chegar, onde fica, se é longe e que horas abre.
canDo: Perguntar Excuse me, how do I get to…?
Dar direção: go straight ahead, turn left, take the first right
Dizer onde fica: on your left, across from, next to, on the corner
Perguntar Is there a… near here? / Is it far?

lines.text: It's Monday, 7:30 AM. Jenny has a new job. She's late!
Excuse me, Tony. How do I get to the hospital?
Go straight ahead for two blocks. Then turn left. No, **actually**, turn right!
Is it far?
No. Ten minutes. It's on your left, across from the bank. **You know**, I never walk!
And is there a pharmacy near here?
Take the first right. It's on the corner, next to the gym. It opens at 8.
Carlos is there, in his new car.
I'm going there too. Come with me!

options: Jenny goes with Carlos in his new car

questions.q: What time does the pharmacy open?

chunks.chunk: Excuse me, how do I get to…?
chunks.pt: Com licença, como eu chego no / na…?
chunks.tip: "Excuse me" é o jeito educado de puxar papo com alguém na rua. E "get to" é chegar num lugar: How do I get to the bank? Vale pra qualquer lugar!
examples: Excuse me, Tony. How do I get to the hospital?
Excuse me. How do I get to the bank?
How do I get to the Sunset Building?

chunks.tip: "Block" é quarteirão, quadra. Uma quadra = one block; duas = two blocks. E repara: em direção, o americano fala "for two blocks" (por duas quadras).
examples: Go straight ahead for two blocks.
Go straight ahead for one block.
Go straight ahead. It's ten minutes.

chunks.chunk: turn left / turn right / take the first right
chunks.pt: vire à esquerda / vire à direita / pegue a primeira à direita
chunks.tip: Pra dar direção, o verbo vem puro e na frente, sem "you": Turn left! Take the first right! É o imperativo, e é só isso mesmo.

chunks.chunk: it's on your left / across from / next to / on the corner
chunks.pt: fica à sua esquerda / em frente a (do outro lado da rua) / ao lado de / na esquina
chunks.tip: Pra dizer onde fica, é "It's…" + o lugar. Cuidado: "across from" é de frente, do outro lado da rua. "In front of" é na frente, coladinho. E esquina é "on the corner", com ON!
examples: It's on your left, across from the bank.
It's on the corner, next to the gym.

alt: It is across from the hospital

practice.pt: Fica na esquina, ao lado do banco.
practice.en: It's on the corner, next to the bank
alt: It is on the corner, next to the bank

chunks.chunk: Is there a… near here? / Is it far? / It opens at…
chunks.pt: Tem um(a)… aqui perto? / É longe? / Abre às…
chunks.tip: O "Is there…?" você já conhece da casa. Agora é na rua: Is there a pharmacy near here? E pro horário da loja: It opens at 8. Com "it", o verbo ganha -s, igual na rotina dele!
examples: Is there a pharmacy near here?
Is it far? No. Ten minutes.

practice.en: Is there a bank near here?

practice.pt: Tem uma academia aqui perto? É longe?
practice.en: Is there a gym near here? Is it far?

grammar.title: Como funciona

Vire à esquerda. / Vire à direita.
It's on your left / on your right.

across from the bank / next to the gym / on the corner
em frente ao banco / ao lado da academia / na esquina
on Main Street / at 1520 Oak Street
na Main Street / no número 1520 da Oak Street

How do I get to…? / Is it far?
Como eu chego no…? / É longe?
grammar.tip: Direção = verbo puro na frente: Turn left! Nada de "You turn left". E endereço em inglês é ao contrário: número antes da rua (1520 Oak Street). Rua sozinha é ON (on Main Street); com número é AT (at 1520 Oak Street).

gossips.title: Where Is Max?

lines.text: It's Friday, 6 PM. Max isn't at home. Carlos is very nervous.
Tony! Is Max at your place?
No. But I can see him from my window!
Where is he? How do I get there?
**Well**, go straight ahead. Take the second left. That's Main Street. He's at Joe's Restaurant, on the corner, across from the bank.
Carlos runs to Main Street. Max is at Joe's, under a big table. And he's eating… guess what!
Max! No! How much is it?
It's 15 dollars. Carlos pays. Max is very happy.

options: On the corner, across from the bank

gossips.title: The Wrong Floor

lines.text: It's Saturday, November 7th. Sam is 15. There's a party tonight at 1520 Oak Street.
Sam, where is it? Is it far?
No, Mom. Cross the street and turn right. Two blocks. The party is on the third floor.
At 8 PM, Sam is there. A man opens the door. It's Mr. Brown, his English teacher!
Sam! **Actually**, the party is on the fourth floor. **By the way**, your homework is on my table.
Oh no… See you on Monday!
Sam goes to the fourth floor. He can hear it!

options: Sam is on the wrong floor
Sam is on the wrong street
Mr. Brown tells Sam the right floor
